caption_note: Material treatment MISSING: painted in concrete_facility -- the last unused-but-one house family. Two packs of runway left.

lamps.why: the recessed panel. A recess throws a HARD pool with a hard edge -- that edge is the whole reason DOOM's lighting is recognisable, and a soft wash would hide the one thing this pack has that no other does.
whatever is being contained, through the blast frame -- warm against everything else, which is how you know it is the wrong kind of warm
fill off the screen wall, so the monitors are legible as monitors

place.why: on the opening; chevrons project toward the player, nothing across or below the head
clear of the approach; the racks face the room because a column you read has to be readable
the desk and its hand-run cable face the room
SUNK into the wall, not hung on it -- the steps go back and the panel sits at the bottom of them
batch043's wall-switch contract: beside the door, at hand height -- the same place as T01-T05's
off the walked line; the stain fans away from the open end
